issue_ledger.title: Typed missingness is not machine-enforced by the v2.5 worker report contract
evidence: schemas/branch_report.schema.json leaves task_ledger, issue_ledger, test_ledger, plan_alignment, negative_zero_outcomes and research_questions as untyped arrays; role_payload is optional and open-ended.

scripts/validate_branch_bus_v251.py validates the generic report schema plus bindings/cost zeros but does not reject a scientific metric encoded as numeric 0 when it should be NOT_MEASURED, nor require an MM03 typed result object.
The frozen MM03 assignment and config/roles.json explicitly require missing metrics to remain typed missing rather than zero.
issue_ledger.impact: A structurally valid countable receipt can satisfy transport validation while omitting MM03's scientific result contract or representing an unmeasured scientific metric as 0 inside an unconstrained payload. This defeats the lane's stated calibration objective and can contaminate later aggregation.
issue_ledger.smallest_v25_fix: Add a frozen $defs MetricResult with required status/type/reason fields and conditional value semantics (MEASURED => numeric value allowed; NOT_MEASURED/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE => value must be null), require the MM03 role payload to contain the typed SlopCode result, and add negative tests showing numeric 0 for NOT_MEASURED is rejected. Because cohort 1 is already active, treat the authoritative hardening as streak-resetting per the v2.5 freeze rule.
issue_ledger.falsifier: Construct a schema-valid MM03 report that omits role_payload entirely, or sets role_payload.slopcode_result={"status":"NOT_MEASURED","value":0}. If the frozen schema/validator rejects both cases, this issue is falsified.

issue_ledger.title: Standardized header phase grammar is stale relative to strict full-phase equality
evidence: SESSION_STANDARD.md presents PHASE as one of generic tokens such as T0/E1/G1/C1.
BRANCH_WORKER_PROTOCOL.md requires the first visible header to copy the full phase exactly from frozen assignment/control.
scripts/validate_branch_bus_v251.py enforces session_header.phase == assignment.phase; the active assignment phase is T0_COUNTABLE_REPLAY_COHORT_1.
issue_ledger.impact: A worker following the header template literally with PHASE=T0 can fail strict session validation despite otherwise following SESSION_STANDARD.md, creating avoidable countable-cohort transport failures.
issue_ledger.smallest_v25_fix: Change the session header template to PHASE: <exact frozen assignment phase> (optionally document canonical phase family separately) and add a negative test that generic T0 is rejected when the assignment carries a longer phase string.
issue_ledger.falsifier: If SESSION_STANDARD.md is amended or formally interpreted by another frozen rule so that its phase placeholder is explicitly non-enumerative and strict full-assignment phase is unambiguous, this documentation-contract issue is closed.
